title: YouTube Automation Manager Update
title_km: ការធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាព YouTube Automation Manager
message: A new version of YouTube Automation Manager is available with the latest features and stability fixes.
message_km: មានកំណែថ្មីនៃ YouTube Automation Manager ជាមួយមុខងារទំនើបៗ និងការជួសជុលប្រព័ន្ធឱ្យកាន់តែមានស្ថេរភាព។
release_notes: Telegram Notification Service for real-time mobile upload alerts (Channel name, schedule time, video title, success/failure status)
Desktop event filter performance boost eliminating packaged application UI lag
Fully responsive table data columns, rows, and progress bars across all screen sizes
System security, UI responsiveness, and stability enhancements
